progress: V0.3.1 Goal Contract PASS; V0.3.2 Task Planner implemented and awaiting CI verification
current_work: Task Planner now converts one GoalContract into an explicit dependency-safe Analyze -> Implement -> Verify plan. The planner is deterministic in V0.3.2, preserves goal success criteria and constraints, validates task IDs/dependencies/sequencing, serializes plans to JSON, and does not execute tasks yet. A read-only terminal watcher was also added so remote project progress can be observed continuously without modifying the local working tree.
next_step: Verify V0.3.2 in GitHub Actions. If green, freeze the planner contract and implement V0.3.3 Task State Machine with READY/RUNNING/VERIFYING/COMPLETE plus FAILED/RETRY/REPAIR/REPLAN transitions.
finish_line: V0.3 completes when one natural-language goal can be planned, routed through the supervisor state machine, executed across tasks, recovered on failure, and reported as GOAL COMPLETE in a real multi-step E2E.
user_action: Optional: run scripts/watch_project_status.py in a terminal to see remote development status updates continuously. No manual verification is required yet.
